subject: Fix prefetchNextBucketEntries so it fetches the correct next 2 buckets (#2394)
reason: The change only corrects which buckets prefetchNextBucketEntries passes to __builtin_prefetch during hashtable iteration. Prefetch is a pure cache hint with no architectural effect, the looked-up buckets are bounds-checked and valid in both the old and new code, and the result never affects iteration order, returned entries, replies, or any server state. It is a performance fix with no behaviour change, so no reply comparison, fault injection, or oracle can observe it.
